_doc: Evolution and hero variants, built from the saved wiki pages by tools/add_variants.py. Stats: every headline column that differs from the base card (hitpoints, damage, ...) is stored as variants.<v>.level_overrides for L11-L21 (the hero tables run to 21); 'stats_extra' adds ability numbers. Evolutions whose behaviour is not simulated carry a planned kind (mechanics.base.PLANNED): their cycles and stats are data, `CardDB.variant_simulated` is false and they can't be picked. Heroes that are simulated carry a champion_ability (see mechanics/abilities.py).

assumed: the 5 shrapnel fan out over 40 degrees around the shot direction and stop 11 tiles (Projectile Range) from her
a small spark sits where each shrapnel stops (the wiki: shrapnel 'leave sparks behind')
sparks hit air and ground, troops, buildings and towers (crown-tower column)
the initial shot keeps the base card's single-target hit
spark damage read from the Small Spark columns: the wiki's L11 Big Spark Damage (12) is a typo (DPS 192 = 48 x 4)
the new Skeleton spawns 0.5 tiles behind the attacker with no deploy time (it still waits its first-hit time)
the cap of 8 counts living Skeletons of the same play
a pulse every time it comes up from underground (the first time right after deploying, if not hidden) and when it dies
the pulse doesn't damage crown towers (no crown-tower column on the page)
radius 5.0: the wiki history cut it from 5.5 to 5 (1/12/2025); the attribute table still says 5.5
one damage hit per attack at the start of the 0.5 s tornado; pull speed as the Tornado spell (3.6 tiles/s)
the table's tornado damage is taken as current (the 4/8/2026 -50% change can't be checked from the page)
the second hit lands 0.5 s after the first (the wiki gives no delay)
enemy towers are taunted too
enemies keep the lock until he is defeated (the taunt itself lasts 5 s)
pancake meter not simulated: the ability always gives the 0-bar bonus (+1 level)
the heal applies on top of the level gain
pulse spacing 0.5 s
the blizzard stays where he stood when it started
towers take the pulse damage in full
spawn damage radius 1.5
turret hitpoints = 10 x its hitpoints-lost-per-second (the page's 'Turret Hitpoints' at L11 equals the Musketeer's own hp, an apparent copy error)
turret hit speed 0.5 s from damage / dps
the 5.5-tile dash at the start is not simulated
hits ground troops, buildings and towers
hit speed 0.5 s (damage 140 / dps 280)
hitpoints = 10 x hitpoints lost per second, so it ends exactly at its 10 s lifetime
